sb_prompt: FIND OUT FROM THE OTHER CALLER WHAT KIND OF CAMPING THEY HAVE DONE.  HOW DOES IT COMPARE WITH YOUR OWN EXPERIENCES?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!
ParticipantA: How are you doing today?
ParticipantB: I'm doing well, thanks for asking. How about you?
ParticipantA: I'm doing pretty good too. So, what brings you to call today?
ParticipantB: Well, I was hoping to talk to someone about their camping experiences. Have you done much camping in your life?
ParticipantA: Yes, I have done quite a bit of camping over the years. I used to go on camping trips with my family when I was younger and I still enjoy it today.
ParticipantB: That's great! I've done some camping too, but not as much as you it seems. I've only gone on a few camping trips with my family, but I really enjoyed it.
ParticipantA: What kind of camping have you done? Have you tried any specific type of camping?
ParticipantB: Most of my camping experiences have been tent camping. We would usually set up our tents in a state park and spend the weekend hiking and exploring the area.
ParticipantA: I've done a lot of tent camping too, but I also enjoy going on more extreme camping trips like backpacking and rock climbing.
ParticipantB: Wow, that sounds really adventurous! I've never tried anything like that before, but I would love to.
ParticipantA: Yeah, it can be a bit intense, but it's also a lot of fun. What kind of camping do you prefer?
ParticipantB: I think I prefer the more relaxed style of camping, like tent camping. I enjoy the peace and quiet of being out in nature and just relaxing.
ParticipantA: Yeah, that's definitely a great way to experience camping. I also enjoy the peacefulness of being out in nature, but I also love the adrenaline rush of doing something more extreme.
ParticipantB: I can see how that would be exciting. Maybe I'll have to try something more extreme next time I go camping.
ParticipantA: Definitely! It's always good to push yourself out of your comfort zone and try new things.
ParticipantB: Yes, I agree. Thanks for talking to me about your camping experiences. It was really interesting to hear about your adventures.
ParticipantA: No problem, it was great talking to you too. Have a great day!
ParticipantB: You too!
